newsitem.title: USA: Xybernaut says considering financing offers.
newsitem.headline: Xybernaut says considering financing offers.

text.p: Xybernaut Corp said Monday it has adequate cash to fund current levels of business activities in the near term, and it is considering several financing proposals.
The company said the financing proposals, which have favorable terms, are from investment banks and other sources of capital.
The company said due diligence has been substantially completed for several financing sources, and it expects to sign a letter of intent in the near future, with funding to follow shortly thereafter.
The company reported a net loss per share of $0.19 for the first quarter ended March 31 compared to a loss of $0.06 for the same period a year ago.
